models.summary: Five EES FUNCTIONs returning the Nusselt number of natural convection from an isothermal surface: Churchill-Chu for a vertical plate (smooth laminar-to-turbulent transition, valid on the whole Rayleigh-number range), McAdams, VDI Heat Atlas and Rohsenow-Hartnett-Cho for a horizontal plate (each with the buoyancy-assisted hot-plate form and the cold-plate form of its lower surface, the McAdams and VDI ones being non-smooth switches between the laminar and turbulent branches) and Churchill for a sphere. Pr and Gr are arguments, so the calling model passes them; the heat-transfer coefficient follows from h = Nu*k/L_c and is left to the caller.
models.tags: free convection;natural convection;nusselt number;correlation;vertical plate;horizontal plate;sphere;function library
models.authors: Caleb Bell (ht library); S. W. Churchill and H. H. S. Chu (Churchill-Chu vertical-plate correlation); W. H. McAdams (McAdams horizontal-plate correlations); V. D. I., VDI Heat Atlas, with K. Stewartson 1958 and E. U. Schluender 1987 (VDI horizontal-plate correlations); W. Rohsenow, J. Hartnett and Y. Cho (Rohsenow-Hartnett-Cho horizontal-plate correlations); S. W. Churchill, as presented in E. U. Schluender (1987) (Churchill sphere correlation)

models.name: external_crossflow_cylinder
models.title: External forced convection: crossflow over a single cylinder (function library)
models.summary: Eight EES FUNCTIONs returning the average Nusselt number of a single circular cylinder in crossflow: Zukauskas (piecewise in Re, with the wall-Prandtl correction), Churchill-Bernstein, Sanitjai-Goldstein, Fand, McAdams, Whitaker and the two forms of Perkins-Leppert (1962 and 1964), the last three with the viscosity-ratio correction. Re, Pr, Prw and the viscosities are arguments, so the calling model passes them; the surface heat-transfer coefficient follows from h = Nu*k/D and is left to the caller.

models.name: tube_bank_nusselt
models.title: Crossflow tube banks: Nusselt-number correlations and row / angle correction factors (function library)
models.summary: Six EES FUNCTIONs for the forced convection across a bank of plain tubes: the Nusselt numbers of Zukauskas with the Bejan fit, of ESDU 73031 as given by Hewitt and of the Heat Exchanger Design Handbook, plus the tube-row correction factor of Zukauskas, the tube-row correction factor of ESDU 73031 and its bundle-inclination correction factor. The Nusselt number is taken on the tube outside diameter, so the heat-transfer coefficient follows from h = Nu*k/Do and is left to the caller. The seventh function of the ht family, Nu_Grimison_tube_bank, is a fitted spline surface in ht and is not translated (see the README).

models.title: In-tube two-phase non-boiling heat-transfer coefficients (function library)

models.name: air_cooler_air_side
models.title: Air-cooled heat exchanger, air side: finned-bundle HTC, pressure drop and fan noise (function library)
models.summary: Eight EES FUNCTIONs for the air side of an air cooler (a finned tube bundle crossed by air): the air-side heat-transfer coefficient on a bare-tube basis (Briggs-Young, ESDU high-fin, ESDU low-fin, Ganguli/VDI), the air-side pressure drop across the bundle (ESDU high-fin and low-fin) and the sound pressure level of a one-fan bay (GPSA, Mukherjee). models.name: free_conv_enclosed_and_jackets
models.title: Natural convection in enclosures and vessels: plates, critical Rayleigh numbers, helical coils, vessel jackets (function library)
models.summary: Ten EES FUNCTIONs for the natural convection of an enclosed fluid layer, of a helical coil in a tank and of a vessel jacket: the Rayleigh-Benard Nusselt numbers between parallel horizontal plates (Holling-Herwig as its residual, Probert, Hollands with a user-supplied critical Rayleigh number), between vertical plates (Thess, aspect ratio), the critical Rayleigh number of parallel disks (Buell-Caton polynomial), the helical-coil correlations of Ali, Prabhanjan-Rennie-Raghavan and Xin-Ebadian (vertical or horizontal), and the average heat-transfer coefficient of a vessel jacket (Lehrer, Stein-Schmidt, tangential or radial inlet, with or without the buoyancy contribution).

models.name: external_forced_conv_plates
models.title: External forced convection over a flat plate (function library)
models.summary: Four EES FUNCTIONs returning the average Nusselt number of an isothermal flat plate in crossflow at constant surface temperature: Baehr-Stephan (laminar, piecewise in the Prandtl number), Churchill-Ozoe (laminar, one equation for the whole range), Schlichting (turbulent, with the surface-friction term of that formulation) and Kreith (turbulent). models.name: supercritical_internal_nu
models.title: Near-supercritical internal convection: Nusselt-number correlations for vertical upward pipe flow (function library)
models.summary: Eighteen EES FUNCTIONs returning the Nusselt number of turbulent vertical upward flow in a pipe at near-supercritical pressure: McAdams, Shitsman, Griem, Jackson, Gupta, Swenson, Xu, Mokry, Bringer-Smith, Ornatsky, Gorban, Zhu, Bishop, Yamagata, Kitoh, Krasnoshchekov-Protopopov, Petukhov and Krasnoshchekov. models.name: tube_bank_dp_bell_delaware
models.title: Shell-and-tube pressure drop: Kern and the Bell-Delaware correction factors (function library)
models.summary: Six EES FUNCTIONs for the shell side of a shell-and-tube heat exchanger: the bundle pressure drop by the equivalent-diameter method of Kern (its friction factor is the cubic B-spline of ht, reproduced in EES arithmetic with the Cox-de Boor basis functions), and the five Bell-Delaware correction factors Jc (baffle configuration, Chebyshev fit or HEDH linear fit), Jl (baffle leakage), Jb (bundle bypassing, with the laminar coefficient), Js (unequal baffle spacing) and Jr (adverse temperature gradient in laminar flow). One helper, Kern_knot_step, evaluates a half-open knot interval. dP_Zukauskas of the same ht family is not translated (bivariate splines of digitized graphs, no closed form).
